description:
The kernel packages contain the Linux kernel, the core of any Linux operating system.  

Security Fix(es):  

  * kernel: Linux kernel: Denial of Service due to NULL function pointer race in timer shutdown (CVE-2025-68214)
  * kernel: procfs: avoid fetching build ID while holding VMA lock (CVE-2026-23199)


Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):  

  * [Lenovo] Graphics not working on T14 G7 Intel (Pantherlake) (JIRA:AlmaLinux-172832)
  * Possible regression with FM350GL [almalinux-10.2.z] (JIRA:AlmaLinux-184266)
  * [10.2 FEAT] CNB102: dpll: sync with upstream (JIRA:AlmaLinux-211011)
  * backport make module and modules-core provides use variant [almalinux-10.2.z] (JIRA:AlmaLinux-213965)


For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
solution:
